subject: Catalyst AI — on-camera runbook & usage rights (draft)
messages:
From: Ava Simmons <ava.simmons@catalystai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Short customer spotlight — availability + questions

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for offering to put together a short on-camera spotlight about our deployment of Redwood Inference. We think this could be a great piece to highlight reduced latency and cost savings — happy to be on camera. A few quick items before we lock a date: 

- Our team availability: week of May 24 works best (we can do morning PT).
- On scope: we prefer a 4–6 minute edited piece focusing on technical outcomes + product fit.
- Rights: we need a short consent that clarifies usage (marketing channels, duration, ability to edit). Can you share the draft release?
- Logistics: will you need b-roll of our office and screen capture of dashboards? We may be limited on in-person access.

Can you send a proposed run-of-show and a release we can run through legal? Also let me know what recording options you have (onsite crew vs remote/Zoom).

Best,
Ava Simmons
Director of Product Marketing | Catalyst AI
ava.simmons@catalystai.com
+1-415-555-0187

Attachment: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Simmons <ava.simmons@catalystai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short customer spotlight — availability + questions

Hi Ava — great to hear. We're excited to feature Catalyst AI. Quick responses and a first pass attached: 

- Dates: proposing Tue May 25 or Thu May 27, mornings PT (08:30–11:30). Which would you prefer?
- Format: remote interview (Zoom / Riverside) with optional short screen-share capture of the Redwood dashboard. If you can do brief phone screen-recording during the call, we can capture the dashboard without needing an on-site shoot.
- Run-of-show: attached is a one-page runbook with questions and suggested camera script. We aim for a 5-minute final cut, but will capture up to ~20 minutes of raw interview for editing.
- Release: attached is our standard testimonial consent (Redwood_Testimonial_Consent_v1.pdf). It includes 12-month marketing usage, non-sensitive editing clause, and an option to request revisions to final cut. If you need tighter terms, flag them and we can route to legal.

Attachments: Interview_Runbook_v1.docx (Q list + producer notes), Redwood_Testimonial_Consent_v1.pdf (consent draft)

Next steps: please confirm preferred date, who will be on camera (names / titles), and any required legal edits. Marissa will run day-of logistics and craft the call sheet once date is confirmed.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cell: +1-650-555-0123

From: Ava Simmons <ava.simmons@catalystai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Rhee <tom.rhee@catalystai.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short customer spotlight — availability + questions

Thanks Karthik — Thu May 27 morning works best for us (we can do 09:00 PT). Attending on our side: Tom Rhee (VP Eng) and me.

A few notes after reading the runbook and consent: 

- Runbook: we like the flow but would prefer one less technical question about kernel-level optimization (too deep for our spokesperson). Can you swap that with a question about "decision process and business outcomes"?
- Release: our legal flagged two items: (1) remove the blanket 12-month limit and change to "24 months"; (2) add a clause that we can request a private review before public release. I attached a short markup in-line below.
- B-roll: we can provide screen captures of the Redwood dashboard and 30 seconds of office footage. No on-site crew — we'll send high-res clips after the call.

Inline edit (excerpt):
> Section: Usage Term — change "12 months" to "24 months"
> Section: Final Cut Approval — add "Customer may request one review cycle prior to public release."

If that looks reasonable, can you send an updated consent and runbook v2? Also please share the expected recording length and whether you will use an external editor or in-house.

Best,
Ava

--

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Simmons <ava.simmons@catalystai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short customer spotlight — availability + questions

Hi Ava — thanks for the quick review and the helpful edit suggestions. We made the requested changes and attached updated documents: 

- Interview_Runbook_v2.docx: removed the kernel-level question; replaced with a Business Outcomes prompt and a customer ROI story anchor. We also tightened the timing (aiming for 6–8 minutes final, 18–22 minutes raw).
- Redwood_Testimonial_Consent_v2.pdf: updated term to 24 months and added the one-review cycle clause. We left a single checkbox for an optional extension if you want indefinite usage; you can check that post-approval.

Editorial notes: our vendor editor will do the first assembly cut; we will share a private review link for your one review cycle. After incorporating your feedback we'll produce the final cut for public distribution. If you'd prefer an in-house editor, let us know and we can route source files.

Attachments: Interview_Runbook_v2.docx, Redwood_Testimonial_Consent_v2.pdf

Logistics notes: Marissa will serve as day-of producer and will share the call sheet and Zoom link. We will also provide an S3 upload for any B-roll you send.

Thanks again — looking forward to May 27 at 09:00 PT. 

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference
